preconditions.description: T is a positive integer representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(N, int) and isinstance(k, int) and N >= 1 and k >= 0 for N, k in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, N is a positive integer (1 ≤ N ≤ 10^5) and k is a non-negative integer (0 ≤ k ≤ 10^18).

preconditions.expression: all(len(A) == N and all(isinstance(x, int) and x >= 0 for x in A) for A in arrays)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the array A has exactly N non-negative integers (0 ≤ A_i ≤ 10^18).

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, int) and result >= 0 for result in results)
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is a non-negative integer representing the number of valid pairs (i, j) where 1 ≤ i < j ≤ N.

postconditions.expression: all(result == sum(1 for i in range(N) for j in range(i+1, N) if (A[i] | A[j]) + (A[i] ^ A[j]) + (A[i] & A[j]) == k + A[j]) for (N, k, A), result in zip(test_cases, arrays, results))
postconditions.description: The result for each test case is the count of pairs (i, j) where the bitwise condition (A_i | A_j) + (A_i ^ A_j) + (A_i & A_j) == k + A_j holds true.
